name: poly-mpe8-synth
description: MPE-capable Web MIDI synthesizer with dual oscillators, 8-note polyphony, and resonant low-pass filter

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const p = 'ios/App/App/capacitor.config.json'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { const c = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p)); c.packageClassList = ['CoreMidiPlugin']; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(c, null, '\t')); } })"
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap open android
scripts.build:all: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/build-ipa.js && node scripts/build-apk.js
